desc:
A battlegrounds game that is a blend of multiple other games.

Included media: Street Fighter, Jujutsu Kaisen
Inspired by: Jujutsu Shenanigans, The Strongest Battlegrounds, Street Fighter

Team and Contributors:
- Scripters: @TheLostRobotlx (SevenBurgers)
- Animators: @TheLostRobotlx (SevenBurgers) @IvanTheKotik (Ivan)
- SFX: @TheLostRobotlx (SevenBurgers)
- VFX: @IvanTheKotik (Ivan) @TheLostRobotlx (SevenBurgers)
- Builders: @Numbermemory @Phonsue
- Artist: @kegloworm
- Modeler: @artistryat_itsfinest
- Menu Announcer: @pizzaanddoglover384 (Daiorg)

Controls:
M1 - Light Attack
F - Block
Q + Direction - Dash/Evasive
1,2,3,4... - Moves
E - Grab
V - Unique Ability
G - Awakening
U - Does absolutely nothing.

Thank you to whoever fought for the game to be back!
